scientific_integrity: The \(n\ge3\) theorem is established by an exact undominated-edge invariant, legal-move classification, length identity, and factorial bijective count; two independent finite checkers corroborate \(n\le11\) and odd attachment enumeration \(n\le7\).
scientific_limitations: The odd-order ordered-sequence count does not enumerate distinct underlying trees. No even-order ordered-sequence count is asserted. Primary sources and indexed results were compared, but unindexed prior work cannot be ruled out. Independent scholarly validation has not been performed.
title: Matching-attachment rigidity of longest total dominating sequences in triangular graphs
